description_en: Queries nodes based on the output of the nodes
description_zh: 根据节点的输出结果精确查询目标节点
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-nodes-by-output --project-env PROD --outputs aaaaa.1231412_out,bbbb.12313123_out --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodesByOutput

parameters.help_en: The environment of Operation Center. Valid values: PROD and DEV. The value PROD indicates the production environment, and the value DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 调度运维中心的环境标识，PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The output name of the node. You can specify multiple output names. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点的输出名称。支持配置多个输出名称，配置多个名称时请使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: outputs
